studies.title: Mount Fuji
studies.caption: Fuji’s volcanic cone stands beyond a quiet lake, with its upper slopes reflected in the water.
studies.prompt: Quiet shore of a Fuji Five Lakes lake with dark reeds and low pines at edges, Mount Fuji's broad symmetrical volcanic cone and restrained snow cap reflected in still water. Low eye level; no pagoda, modern town, power lines or cherry-blossom cliché.
